column3: Proposed deviation (default taken, owner may reverse): the orm journal source maps to the sqlalchemy-statistics panel, the nearest sharpit panel to BootUI's hibernate (JournalSourcePanels.java:45).

Proposed deviation (default taken, owner may reverse): the processes and files sources (sharpit's own W6 sensors; BootUI 2.3.0 has no such sources) map to the side-effects panel, where BootUI keeps them in its Side Effects store.

Proposed deviation (default taken, owner may reverse): rest-client, messaging, fault-tolerance and websocket map to no panel (always visible) because sharpit has no rest-client-trace, kafka/rabbitmq/jms, fault-tolerance or websockets panel; whether such a source counts as recorded still depends on PRODUCED_SOURCES (JournalSourcePanels.java:36-44).

With the http-exchanges panel off, request-reading kinds answer NOT_APPLICABLE "The http-exchanges panel is disabled, so its unit-of-work evidence cannot be evaluated." as BootUI (RuntimeInsightsService missingSource :1362-1368); base evaluated them.
